deadline.value: December 15, 2026 deadline for Fall semester admission

gre_general.value: General GRE scores are not considered as part of application packages.
gre_general.quote: We will not consider GRE scores, either general or physics, as part of application packages for the 2026-2027 application cycle.

gre_subject.value: Physics Subject GRE scores are not considered as part of application packages.
gre_subject.quote: We will not consider GRE scores, either general or physics, as part of application packages for the 2026-2027 application cycle.

supervisor.value: Pre-application faculty supervisor contact is not stated as required.

funding.value: Entering graduate students are typically supported by teaching or research assistantships.
funding.quote: Most entering graduate students are initially supported by a teaching assistantship, which pays the student’s tuition and provides a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.
